    elseif op == 0x8E then stack[a] = -(stack[b] or 0); pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x3F then stack[a] = not stack[b]; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0xF1 then stack[a] = #(stack[b] or ""); pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0xB1 then local res = ""; for i = b, c do res = res .. tostring(stack[i] ~= nil and stack[i] or "") end; stack[a] = res; pc = pc + 1;

    elseif op == 0xE2 then if (not not stack[a]) ~= (c ~= 0) then pc = pc + 1 end; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x47 then if (not not stack[b]) ~= (c ~= 0) then pc = pc + 1 else stack[a] = stack[b] end; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x91 then
      local fn = stack[a]; local args = {};
      if b == 0 then for i = a + 1, top do _ins(args, stack[i]) end
      else for i = a + 1, a + b - 1 do _ins(args, stack[i]) end end;

      if vm_meta then
        _ins(cstack, {cur_p = cur_p, code = code, k = k, psubs = psubs, pc = pc + 1, stack = stack, top = top, upvals = upvals, varargs = varargs, dest = a, cnt = c});

        upvals = vm_meta.upvals or {}; varargs = args; stack = {};

      else

        if rets[1] then
          local n_rets = #rets - 1;
          if c == 0 then top = a + n_rets - 1; for i = 1, n_rets do stack[a + i - 1] = rets[i + 1] end;
          elseif c > 1 then for i = 1, c - 1 do stack[a + i - 1] = rets[i + 1] end end;
          pc = pc + 1;
        else error(rets[2]) end;
      end;
    elseif op == 0x59 then

      if b == 0 then for i = a + 1, top do _ins(args, stack[i]) end
      else for i = a + 1, a + b - 1 do _ins(args, stack[i]) end end;
      return fn(_unpack(args, 1, #args));
    elseif op == 0xEA then

      if b == 0 then for i = a, top do _ins(rets, stack[i]) end
      elseif b > 1 then for i = a, a + b - 2 do _ins(rets, stack[i]) end end;
      if #cstack > 0 then
        local caller = _rem(cstack);
        cur_p = caller.cur_p; code = caller.code; k = caller.k; psubs = caller.psubs;
        pc = caller.pc; stack = caller.stack; top = caller.top; upvals = caller.upvals; varargs = caller.varargs;
        local dest = caller.dest; local cnt = caller.cnt;
        if cnt == 0 then top = dest + #rets - 1; for i = 1, #rets do stack[dest + i - 1] = rets[i] end;
        elseif cnt > 1 then for i = 1, cnt - 1 do stack[dest + i - 1] = rets[i] end end;
      else return _unpack(rets, 1, #rets) end;
    elseif op == 0x30 then
      local step = stack[a + 2]; local idx = stack[a] + step; local limit = stack[a + 1];
      if (step > 0 and idx <= limit) or (step <= 0 and idx >= limit) then
        stack[a] = idx; stack[a + 3] = idx; pc = pc + b + 1;
      else pc = pc + 1 end;
    elseif op == 0x6B then
      local init = stack[a]; local limit = stack[a + 1]; local step = stack[a + 2];
      stack[a] = init - step; pc = pc + b + 1;
    elseif op == 0x17 then
      local f = stack[a]; local s = stack[a + 1]; local var = stack[a + 2];
      local rets = {_pcall(f, s, var)};
      if rets[1] and rets[2] ~= nil then
        for i = 1, c do stack[a + 2 + i] = rets[1 + i] end;
        stack[a + 2] = rets[2]; pc = pc + 1;
      else pc = pc + 2 end;
    elseif op == 0x0A then
      local t = stack[a]; for i = 1, b do t[(c - 1) * 50 + i] = stack[a + i] end; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x75 then
      local target_pid = psubs[b + 1] or (b + 1);
      local cl = function(...) return v966(target_pid, stack, ...) end;
      v967[cl] = {pid = target_pid, upvals = stack};
      stack[a] = cl; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0x8B then
      if b == 0 then for i = 1, #varargs do stack[a + i - 1] = varargs[i] end; top = a + #varargs - 1;
      else for i = 1, b - 1 do stack[a + i - 1] = varargs[i] end end; pc = pc + 1;
    elseif op == 0xAE then
      local chunk = k[b + 1];
      local _loader = loadstring or (getgenv and getgenv().loadstring) or load;
      if _loader then
        local fn, err = _loader(chunk);
        if fn then
          if setfenv then pcall(setfenv, fn, v965); end;
          local rets = {_pcall(fn, ...)};
          if rets[1] then
            local n_rets = #rets - 1;
            if c == 0 then
              top = a + n_rets - 1;
              for i = 1, n_rets do stack[a + i - 1] = rets[i + 1]; end;
            elseif c > 1 then
              for i = 1, c - 1 do stack[a + i - 1] = rets[i + 1]; end;
            end;
            pc = pc + 1;
          else
            error(rets[2]);
          end;
        else
          error(err);
        end;
      else
        error("Execution loader not found in current environment");
      end;
    else pc = pc + 1 end;
  end;
end;
return function(...) return v966(1, {}, ...) end;
